items.title: Florida State Makes Football Leadership Change
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE, Fla. — Florida State University President Richard McCullough informed head football coach Mike Norvell Sunday afternoon that FSU is making a change in the leadership of its football program, effective immediately. FSU Athletics Hall of Fame member Rick Stockstill has been named interim head coach.

items.title: Florida State Reveals Elevated Game Day Experience for October 31 Contest in Doak Campbell Stadium
items.summary: TALLAHASSEE – The Florida State athletics department announced on Friday an elevated game day experience for the football team's October 31 home contest against Clemson.
